name: TD-3 Switch Coherence
description: Top-down context-assurance test (TOP_DOWN_REVIEW_GUIDE.md §4, TD-3): run the same real regulated-topic prompt twice — once against the default/primary configured model, once with a model_override forcing the local fallback (BitNet-class) — then compare both real capture-store entries for decision coherence over the identical traversed context. Productizes this session's BitNet coherency-sweep methodology as a standing, registered test rather than a one-off manual sweep.

steps.description: Submit a real RequireConfirmation-matching prompt through /orchestrate using the host's default configured model (no override) — establishes the baseline real decision + reasoning.

Submit the identical prompt again, this time with a model_config override forcing the local BitNet-class fallback model for the review call specifically (mirrors this session's real forced-model BitNet coherency sweep methodology, now scoped to the decision-review call site).

Read both real capture-store lines ({data_dir}/model_calls/decision_review.jsonl) and compare decision agreement + whether the fallback model's reasoning still cites the same real traversed context markers as the primary model's — the real, measurable definition of 'switch coherence' this session's doctrine calls for.
